indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Slipped about 29 points as a hotter inflation report lifted rate-hike bets.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Fell about 187 points, with Nvidia the biggest drag.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Gave back about 158 points of Monday's 1,104-point jump.

notes: October consumer prices rose 0.4% for the month and core prices 0.3%, both a tenth above forecasts; there is no annual rate this time because October 2025 data was lost to the shutdown.
Traders now put roughly an 84% chance on a quarter-point Fed hike in December, and some started pricing a half-point move; Treasury yields climbed toward 5%.
Nvidia dropped about 5.5% to near $169 as scrutiny of CEO Jensen Huang widened, including a board probe and a report on chip shipments to China; gold, oil and bitcoin also fell.
events: Wed 11 Nov: Veterans Day; stock markets open, bond market closed.
Thu 19 or Fri 20 Nov: Anthropic's IPO is expected to start trading on Nasdaq, priced at $70–78 a share.
Wed 9 Dec, 22:00 Kuwait time: Federal Reserve rate decision.
